title: TEKKEN 7
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#145, 2026-09-20): rated 4, playable with minor issues, D3DMetal, Apple M1, macOS 26.7, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r5, Highball 0.9.31, a standalone (non-Steam) copy run through Highball for 52 minutes: Story campaign to Chapter 3, occasional choppiness, DualSense gamepad fine, environment on msync, Windows 10, 96 dpi. Not run here. Second report by JoWood94 (highball-db#664, 2026-10-24), the Steam copy, Apple M1 Pro, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, played on D3DMetal with the environment in DXMT mode, rated 5 of 5 after a one-minute session.
notes: Story mode played to Chapter 3 on D3DMetal on an M1 with occasional choppiness (the reporter's CPU sat around 150%, so likely the M1's GPU rather than the CPU). A DualSense gamepad worked without setup. Tip from the report: the game's Borderless Window mode makes switching to other apps easier. Frame rate not recorded. The Steam copy played fine on an M1 Pro, online included (highball-db#664). Fullscreen offered at most 1521x910, the Mac's scaled size.

knownIssues.symptom: Fullscreen offers at most 1521x910 on an M1 Pro, the size macOS shows for its scaled display (highball-db#664)
knownIssues.cause: games see the display's scaled size unless Retina resolution is on
knownIssues.fix: untested for this game. Retina resolution at 100% in the environment's settings lets games see the full pixel count
